labels.policy: only strict pairs are merged; loose pairs, and any same-name pair not in the reviewed strict list, stay separate classes

splits.seg: Protocol B (artifacts/splits/protocolB_seed4242.csv): train_B only for training; dev_query_B vs gallery_B for selection; test_query_B exploratory (consumed)
splits.plantseg: protocol P (official Training/Validation/Test, duplicate-group disjoint; sha256[:12] 7c545a881b97)
splits.note: no image is moved between splits; no SegPPD or PlantSeg dev/test image is used for training

duplicates.cross_source_pairs_cos_ge_0p85: 0 (frozen DINOv2-B CLS; all 9,289 protocol-P images vs all 2,263 SegPPD images; PlantSeg copies of SegPPD images were already removed by the Track B audit, rule hash OR cos>=0.85)

conditions.S0: SegPPD-only (existing Track A Proxy-Anchor a32 d0.3, seeds 0-2) [source-only encoder]
conditions.T0: PlantSeg-only (existing Track B M3 Proxy-Anchor, seeds 0-2) [target-supervised encoder]
conditions.X1: mixed: SegPPD train_B + PlantSeg train, unified labels, Proxy-Anchor a32 d0.3, 60 steps/epoch, class-balanced PK batches (same budget as T0), 3 seeds
conditions.X2: X1 + ONE change: domain-balanced batches (8 classes drawn from the SegPPD pool + 8 from the PlantSeg pool, images from that source), 3 seeds
conditions.X3: X1 + ONE change: colour/lighting augmentation ('color', the only augmentation within the dev tie band in Track C), 3 seeds

selection: epoch: mean of (SegPPD dev class-macro Hit@1 [dev_query_B vs gallery_B], PlantSeg dev accuracy [official Validation vs <=10 train images per class]); tie band 1/300; inside the band higher mean mAP; patience 6, 30 epochs max. Nothing else is tuned.

evaluation.E1_plantseg_target: queries = protocol-P Test (1,646; 10 shared-class subset reported separately), gallery = protocol-P train (98 classes), relevance = PlantSeg label
evaluation.E2_segppd_target: queries = Protocol B test (225, 75 classes), gallery = gallery_B (809)
evaluation.E3_cross_domain_gallery: queries = protocol-P Test images of the 10 shared classes, gallery = SegPPD gallery_B (75 classes), relevance = unified id (needs no PlantSeg gallery: tests transfer into the SegPPD gallery)

regimes: S0 is source-only for E1 and E3; T0 is target-supervised for E1 and source-only for E2/E3; X* are mixed (supervised on both sources) and are never mixed with S0/T0 in one claim. Reported separately per evaluation.
comparisons: X1 vs T0 (budget-matched: same steps/epoch/classes sampler, PlantSeg-only) on E1/E2/E3; X2 vs X1; X3 vs X1; paired on identical queries, class-bootstrap CIs, 3 seeds averaged per query.
status: EXPLORATORY. No untouched labelled data exists: Protocol B/C tests and the PlantSeg test were inspected earlier. Selection uses only dev sets. Not a confirmatory test.
organ_analysis: Only verified organ labels may be used. None exist (the 121 provisional labels have a single AI annotator, unverified). No organ result is produced; a blank verification worksheet is exported instead.
